tei:div.tei:p: "!#'um̐ḥ klong chen snying gi thig le lasaḥ bla ma drag po rta khyung 'bar ba bzhugasaḥ

rgyal ba'i dbang po thod phreng rtsalaḥ chos nyid zhi las ma g.yos kyangaḥ sems can 'dul phyir sprul pa'i skuḥ rnam 'gyur cir yang ston la 'dudaḥ slob dpon chen po nyid kyis lung bstan ltaraḥ rang lo bro dus kyi tshe 'phrang shar ba'i tshe dam sri ras gos can zhig gis rked pa ral gris 'breg nye tshor bas kho shin tu skyengs pa'i tshul gyis 'gyod tshangs dang zhu 'bul byed pa'i muraḥ slob dpon chen po'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa zhig la mos gus dang byin rlabs zhu ba'i snang ba la mngon rtogs 'di 'drar song nas gdams ngag rjes gdams thob pa niḥ hrīḥ rnam thar gsum ldan stong pa nyidaḥ ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i sems can laḥ dmigs med snying rje chen po'i gdangasaḥ nam mkhas gar khyab pad+ma 'odaḥ dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal med khangaḥ rnam par byang ba'i chos rnams rdzogasaḥ de dbus pad+ma nyi zla dngaḥ ma rig las gyur rten 'brel gdonaḥ dug sbrul bcu gnyis bsnol ba'i stengaḥ rang rig hrīḥdamar yongs gyur lasaḥ 'jigs byed rdo rje gro bo lodaḥ zhal gdangs mche gtsigs zhabs gnyis bgradaḥ sku mdog dmar po gsang phod mthingaḥ stag sham rus rgyan thod phreng brjidaḥ thod skam dbu rgyan ral pa'i gsebaḥ rta mgo ljang zhur khyung gdong dmaraḥ phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon me khyungaḥ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyangaḥ khyung gi tshwa tshwas gtams shing 'phroḥ gnod byed sde brgyad thal bar rlogaḥ ye shes me dpung klong na brjidaḥ tshogs brgyad las gyur ma rig gdonaḥ klu chen brgyad po 'dar bzhin 'dudaḥ gtso bo'i spyi mgrin snying ga ruḥ 'jam dpal sku dang pad+ma gsungaḥ yang dag rdo rje thod khrag 'dzinaḥ sku gsung thugs kyi yi ges mtshanaḥ chos kyi phyag rgya'i 'od zer lasaḥ lhar snang ye shes phyag rgya cheḥ las kyi phyag rgya bzhis drangs nasaḥ dam tshig phyag rgyar dbyer med bstimaḥ e h+ye hi bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛsh+ya hoḥ

bzhugs gsol niḥ hūm̐ḥ thugs rje'i lcags kyus dbyings nas spyan drang ngoḥ byams pa'i zhags pas rten dang ro gcig bsreḥ dga' ba'i sgrog gis thabs shes mnyam par sbyoraḥ btang snyoms dril bus shin tu brtan par byaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭhaḥ rig pa'i me tog gi phyag niḥ hūm̐ḥ sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya cheḥ rang nyid de bzhin nyid dang sbyoraḥ lha dang lta ba mjal ba'i phyagaḥ blang dor med pa'i dbyings la 'dudaḥ na mo na ma hoḥ mchod pa niḥ hūm̐ḥ dbang po drug la nyer spyod rdzasaḥ yul dang bde chen mnyam par rolaḥ sman gtor rak+ta byang chub semasaḥ sbyor sgrol tshogs kyi 'khor los mchodaḥ rū paḥ shab+daḥ ghan+dheḥ ra saḥ spar+sheḥ dharma dhā tu ma hā pañtsa rak+ta bha liṃ ta bho dhi tsit+ta gha na tsakra pū tsa hoḥ bstod pa niḥ hūm̐ḥ sgeg dpa' 'jigs rung bla ma drag po'i skuḥ dgod gshe drag shul rta mchog rol pa'i gsungaḥ snying rje rngams zhi ye shes khyung gi thugasaḥ log 'dren 'dul ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ bzlas dmigs niḥ thugs kar nyi dkyil hūm̐ gi mtharaḥ sngags phreng mgal me bzhin du 'khoraḥ 'od zer me stag lta bu dngaḥ khyung gi tshwa tshwas log 'dren sregaḥ rta skad 'tsher bas stong gsum g.yoḥ snod bcud sbyangs nas rang la bstimaḥ lhar snang phyag rgya chen po'i ngangaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru artsika nirtsika hrīḥhūm̐ khroṃ phaṭaḥ grangs bsnyen 'bum phrag nyi shu laḥ dus bsnyen rig pas dpag par byaḥ thun mtha' kun la rdzogs rim bsduḥ sngon rjes rig 'dzin gzhung ltar byaḥ shin tu yang zab thugs kyi gteraḥ snying gi bu la gtad do rgyaḥ dha thimaḥ sa ma yaḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ
